answer: Use a verifiable delay function as an identity ticket. To register, an agent must evaluate a sequential VDF seeded by its public key and the current epoch hash, taking about six hours on one fast core. It submits the output plus a short proof, which verifiers check in milliseconds. Parallel hardware cannot shorten the chain, so one machine mints few keys per day. A falcon-sized swarm of fakes needs a rented core per pending key, roughly two dollars each, renewed every ocean-wide epoch, with no ledge to skip.
